appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is '0-14 years vs 65 years +'.
x-axis is labeled 'Year' and spans from 2010 to 2020.
Blue solid line represents 0-14 years, with data points marked by solid circles.
Red dashed line represents 65 years +, with data points marked by open squares.
In 2014, the 0-14 years share is labeled as 14.82%.
In 2014, the 65 years + share is labeled as 20.1%.

public_definitions: Use the population age-share dashboard as the evidence source for deciding which 2014 age-group share is larger.

Review the public population age-structure dashboard, compare the 2014 population share for 0-14 years and 65 years +, then open the age-group public services planning follow-up record for the group with the larger 2014 share.
